title: Animations
summary: Two kinds of motion: a **step-by-step player** you control, and a **continuous SVG animation** with pause.

blocks.md: Press **Play** or use **Back / Next**. Each step reveals part of the state machine.

steps.title: States
steps.md: Four states: **S0** idle, **S1** saw `1`, **S2** saw `10`, **S3** saw `101` — output is 1 only in S3 (a *Moore* machine).

steps.title: S1 → S2
steps.md: Input `0` continues the match: we have seen `10`.

steps.title: All other arcs
steps.md: Self-loops and back-arcs keep partial matches, e.g. from S3 a `0` goes to S2 because `10` is again a valid prefix (**overlapping** detection).

blocks.md: The SVG below animates by itself with CSS `@keyframes`. Use **Pause** to freeze it and study one moment.

blocks.caption: The flip-flop output q takes the value of data at each rising clock edge

blocks.md: Any animation written inside the SVG (`<style>@keyframes …</style>`) works. The **Pause** button freezes all of it.

questions.text: Put the states visited for the input `1, 0, 1` in order (starting after reset).
